visual_logic.surface_detail: Rugged skin with 'Dark Charcoal' dorsal coloring and subtle scarring to indicate a high-tier predator status, fully displayed across its expansive horizontal side flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Emphasis remains on the 'bitey' nature of the snout—shorter and more robust than Ophthalmosaurus, with prominent teeth cleanly visible in a lateral jawline orientation parallel to the frame edge.
visual_logic.environment: Murky, nutrient-dense Jurassic waters. The suspended sediment is restricted to the background layers to maintain a sharp, measurable horizontal silhouette line around the entire animal.
visual_logic.pose: The ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original head-on lunge is unrolled into a flat, level horizontal swimming path, stretching its robust snout, heavy torso, dorsal fin, and deep tail fluke end-to-end to track flawlessly along the central UI measuring tape system. The jaws remain open parallel to the frame to highlight the prominent predatory teeth.
